content: प्रावृषेण्य {%a.%} .²1 Produced in, relating to, the rainy season; सा किं शक्या जनयितुमिह प्रावृषेण्येन … वारिदेन <ls>Bv. 1. 30</ls>, <ls n="Bv.">4. 6</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 36</ls>; प्रावृषेण्यपयोवाहव्यूहस्तनित … <ls>Rām.</ls> champū. .²2 Abundant, copious, much (<ab>lit.</ab> coming in showers). .²3 To be paid in the rainy season (as a debt <ab>&c.</ab>). .{@-ण्यः@} .²1 The Kadamba tree. .²2 The Kuṭaja tree. .{@-ण्यम्@} Numerousness, abundance, plenty.
